Lost money. Was it a BAD trade? 🤔

Long at a valid level, stop placed at the invalidation, 1% risk, exactly as planned. Price broke the low and took the stop: -1R. Most traders call that a bad trade and change the strategy the next day. But a single trade is just one result from a random distribution. If the plan was followed, the trade was good. The truly bad trade is the impulsive one that breaks your rules and happens to win, because it teaches you the wrong lesson.

1️⃣ Judge every trade by the process, not by the P&L
2️⃣ Followed the plan and lost = good trade, log it and move on
3️⃣ Broke a rule and won = bad trade, it's the most dangerous one
